title: Which planes diffract, and where
caption: Cu Kα from copper (a = 0.3615 nm): Bragg's law puts a reflection with N = √(h² + k² + l²) at 2θ = 2 sin⁻¹(λN/2a). FCC needs h, k, l all even or all odd, so (111) at 2θ ≈ 43.3° and (200) at 50.4° appear, while (100) and (110) (grey) are absent.
alt: Peak angle 2 theta against the square root of h squared plus k squared plus l squared: a rising curve with the 111 and 200 reflections marked present at 43.3 and 50.4 degrees and the 100 and 110 positions marked grey as absent.
description: Positions only: (100) would be at 24.6° and (110) at 35.1°, but mixed parity cancels them in FCC.
